participant: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM approval_instances ai JOIN approval_steps ast ON ast.instance_id=ai.id WHERE ai.record_type='{kind}' AND ai.record_id={alias}.id AND ai.company_id={alias}.company_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ({union}) participant WHERE iam_same_person(participant.user_id,{user},ai.company_id)){role})
participantRoleCheck: AND (ast.state IN ('approved','rejected') OR ast.stage='department_approval' AND jsonb_exists(ast.route_snapshot_json::jsonb,'departmentPolicyVersion') OR ast.stage='hr_approval' AND ast.route_snapshot_json::jsonb->>'appointedPersonId' IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 {from} WHERE aa.id={active} AND iam_role_allows(aa.role,aa.company_id,'workflow.'||COALESCE(ast.required_role,CASE WHEN ast.authority IN ('named','department') THEN 'people_manager' ELSE ast.authority END)) AND aa.company_id=ai.company_id AND (aa.scope_kind='holding' OR aa.scope_kind='branch' AND aa.scope_node_id=ai.branch_id OR aa.scope_kind='department' AND aa.scope_node_id=ai.department_id)))
approvalIndex: (SELECT current_step FROM approval_instances WHERE company_id=d.company_id AND record_id=d.id ORDER BY insertion_order DESC LIMIT 1)
expensePolicyExists: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM approval_steps s JOIN approval_instances i ON i.id=s.instance_id WHERE i.record_type='expense' AND i.record_id=d.id AND i.company_id=d.company_id AND s.ordinal={index} AND jsonb_exists(s.route_snapshot_json::jsonb,'departmentPolicyVersion'))
